scope: semantic_regression lock/check and advisory CI; frozen-evidence narrative only

attribution.acceptance_cards: Original acceptance designs derived from cited source, not NVIDIA certification

boundaries: Hash binds bytes, not reviewer identity or correctness.
Retention and consistency do not establish task correctness.
CI live is advisory; workflow green is not measured pass.
Private Ratchet and its license/dependencies are not verified.
Commands are design material, not execution records.
Runtime tree_digest covers .py/.md excluding __pycache__, not the whole environment.

claims.statement: Lock checks mapping digest, receipt-listed files, runtime digest and external selftest, then refuses existing output directory.
Binding fixes measurement inputs and skill filenames, not author model or skill content; retention selects claims[0] before scoring.
Weak gate with code 0 is incomplete; code 1 is regression. External scoring internals not supplied.
Live requires enabled main push or requested main dispatch and has continue-on-error true; CI never calibrates or locks.
Plan exits 0 without measurement; check exits 2 if any case incomplete, otherwise 1 if regression, else 0.

acceptance_cards.title: Missing baseline
acceptance_cards.precondition: Valid suite; baseline key absent; model counter zero.
acceptance_cards.expected: incomplete/baseline_missing; null metrics; zero model calls; aggregate exit 2.
acceptance_cards.negative: Reject plan exit 0 or missing baseline as measured pass.

acceptance_cards.title: Lock tampering and overwrite
acceptance_cards.precondition: Reviewed packet and matching runtime; fresh output.
acceptance_cards.stimulus: Mutate mapping, receipt-listed file or runtime .py/.md; separately use existing output.
acceptance_cards.expected: Digest mutations rejected; existing output rejected after selftest, without baseline overwrite.
acceptance_cards.negative: Only unchanged valid packet and successful selftest can lock; digest does not prove review identity.

acceptance_cards.title: Binding versus tested variables
acceptance_cards.expected: Binding or baseline digest rejection before candidate model calls; outer report incomplete.
acceptance_cards.negative: Author-only or skill-content-only changes are not necessarily binding mismatches; semantic comparison remains necessary.

acceptance_cards.title: Verbatim evidence
acceptance_cards.precondition: Known raw report and fixed run_id.
acceptance_cards.stimulus: Wrong run_id, removed Markdown or stitched evidence quotations.
acceptance_cards.expected: At most one correction; persistent invalid extraction incomplete; provider failure not retried.
acceptance_cards.negative: Valid substring evidence passes structural validation, not semantic truth validation.

acceptance_cards.title: Exact claim accounting
acceptance_cards.precondition: Authoritative claim IDs, run IDs and core IDs.
acceptance_cards.stimulus: Drop/duplicate/invent partition IDs or retention members; use wrong run or unknown core.
acceptance_cards.expected: Invalid partition gets at most one correction, then clustering_invalid_output; invalid retention mapping rejected.
acceptance_cards.negative: Valid exact partition proves transport completeness only, not semantic grouping quality.

acceptance_cards.title: Negation, first run and empty report
acceptance_cards.precondition: Human-reviewed unmeasured/unproven core findings and thresholds capable of detecting their loss.
acceptance_cards.stimulus: Invert negation in first run while later runs retain it; separately inject empty report.
acceptance_cards.expected: No best-run substitution; damage should be detected and empty runs retained. Actual semantic detection depends on unverified Ratchet/judge.
acceptance_cards.negative: Meaning-preserving rewrite as control; reject measurement configuration if damaged report passes.

acceptance_cards.title: Weak thresholds
acceptance_cards.precondition: Valid nonempty core and external CLI contract available.
acceptance_cards.stimulus: Set th1<=0, jac1-th2<=0 or th1<1/core_count while gate code is 0.
acceptance_cards.expected: incomplete; code 1 takes precedence as regression.
acceptance_cards.negative: Valid thresholds plus code 0 only establish eligibility for measured passed, not task correctness.

acceptance_cards.title: Advisory CI
acceptance_cards.precondition: Separate plan/live/report interpretation; environment protection verified independently.
acceptance_cards.stimulus: PR, disabled live, provisioning failure, regression or interrupted job.
acceptance_cards.expected: Fork PR plan skipped; live only enabled main push or requested main dispatch; fallback plan-only/no artifact never pass.
acceptance_cards.negative: Workflow green cannot substitute for measured pass; no CI calibrate/lock.

blocking_conditions: unapproved executable bundle or data egress
